scenario: [LGRA.5.8.8] with [LFST.9]: the session of `logical/LGRA.5.8.8_parsed_zero_has_no_sign`, recorded and replayed. The Json slot's float zero is +0.0 from the moment the value comes into being, so the recording carries `0.0` and the replay, which reads the slot back through the parser (a recording read on replay is one of [LGRA.5.8.6]'s places), re-derives the same fire and log byte for byte. PATH PINNED: libds records through rfcs/codec.c and replays through ds_rfcs_replay_* (pyds Engine.record / Engine.replay), re-reading the slot's text through `json.c`'s parser; the Mercury runtime records the slot's canonical text (`ds.rfcs` `rfcs_6_3_json_field`) and replays it through `ds.json_text` (`ds.rfcs` `slot_value`), in the behaviour suite's `replay_determinism` driver. A runtime that folded on the live path and not on the replayed read, or the other way round, would differ in `zero_has_no_sign`'s fire and fail the compare.
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule zero_has_no_sign:
    Payload p where 1.0 / p.body.v > 0.0
->
    log info "zero has no sign"
